Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up

to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 5. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER / CORDITE FACTORY ARUVANKADU payable at COONOOR / ARUVANKADU . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER / CORDITE FACTORY ARUVANKADU . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER / CORDITE FACTORY ARUVANKADU payable at COONOOR / ARUVANKADU . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also

(besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER / CORDITE FACTORY ARUVANKADU payable at COONOOR /ARUVANKADU . Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Technical Specification No. 01/MT/Dvr/2026 Dtd. 30.09.2026 I. Scope of Work (Service Contract) i) The Scope of Work is for providing heavy vehicle drivers (Highly Skilled Category) on daily b asis for 08 hrs/day (excluding meal hour), inside factory & outside factory like Coonoor/Ooty / Kotagiri/Coimbatore/Tirupur etc. for a period of 365 days with 50% option clause. II. Details of requirement i. The Service Provider’s drivers should possess the following. a) valid heavy vehicle driving license b) able to speak either Tamil (or) Hindi (or) English c) able to read & write Tamil (or) Hindi (or) English d) age below 55 years & should be physically fit for the intended work. e) endorsement in driving license for “safe transportation of hazardous goods”. However, within 3 months, the Service Provider/firm should arrange for obtaining the endorseme nt in all the drivers’ respective driving licenses on their own cost. ii) The Service Provider’s drivers should attend the duty (round the clock) as per the requireme nt of MT section which will be intimated in advance. iii) The Service Provider’s drivers should be in uniform either in khaki colour cotton material & Safety shoes while on duty. iv) The Service Provider’s drivers should not be under influence of any kind of alcohol/intoxican t, while on duty. v) The Service Provider’s drivers will be asked to drive either light motor vehicle (or) heavy mo tor vehicle based on the necessity/requirement. vi) Even though if the duty timing is completed, the Service Provider’s driver should not leave t

he vehicle (or) work spot till handing over of the vehicle to another driver allotted by MT s ection (or) completion of the work. vii) The Service Provider’s drivers have to carry out other related work like starter battery chec k-up/top-up, radiator coolant check-up/top-up, engine oil check-up/top-up, DEF check-up/t op-up, greasing of vehicle, changing of tyres, washing of the vehicles, assisting the CFA te chnician/mechanic for any other repair work including tyre puncture work, etc. viii) No facility for Accommodation (or) food will be provided by CFA for the Service Provider’s driver and they have to make their own arrangement for the same. ix) Since the driver will be driving CFA (Govt.) vehicles, it is expected that the drivers have to maintain proper code of behavior. x) The Service Provider shall be liable to bear the damage/compensation on account of any inj ury/loss of life/damage to CFA property caused by his driver (or) due their actions. xi) The Service Provider’s driver shall work at their own risk. CFA shall not be responsible for an y injury/death to them during the execution of the contract. xii) The responsibility of any kind of damage to the vehicle (or) Service Provider’s driver (or) th ird party (property damage/injury/loss of life) rests with the Service Provider, in case of an y accident. xiii) The Service Provider’s drivers should submit an undertaking form individually to Cordite Factory Aruvankadu that the work is purely temporary in nature and they should not claim for permanent employment, from C.F. Aruvankadu during the currency of contract (or) aft er completion of the contract. General Terms & Conditions a) The requirement of HMV driver is continuously for 365 days irrespective of Sundays/Holiday s. One weekly off has to be given to each driver within a week as per the requirement/detailment / shift schedule of Motor Transport section of Cordite Factory Aruvankadu. b) If the Service Provider fails to supply the required No. of drivers on daily basis, Rs. 200/- will be deducted per driver/day as penalty. Normally, on Holidays/Sundays the requirement of d rivers will be less compared with normal days. Hence, the requirement on Holidays/Sundays may be reduced as per the discretion/direction of MT section of CFA and the reduced manp ower will be utilized on any other working days. However, the total man days for the entire contract period should not exceed the sanctioned man days. C. Contractor shall disburse the monthly take home remunerations directly into bank accou nt of his employees, as per the latest minimum wages rates as notified by the Office of the Chief Labour Commissioner (Central), Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of Indi th a from time to time, by 7 of succeeding month and submit relevant documents (EPF comb ined challan receipt, wage split-up details, Bank account statement for crediting the wages th to drivers, relevant GST records etc.) by 10 of the same month. The payment should not b e linked to the processing of bills submitted by contractor and there on payment made to co ntractor by CFA. d) The Service Provider has to make necessary arrangement to pay the wages on time to his drivers and then the same may be claimed from the factory.

e) The Service Provider must adhere to the provisions of all the laws/rules of the Govt. such as EPF, Bonus, Insurance etc. f) The Service Provider has to make necessary arrangement to provide proper insurance cover age to their drivers such as Workmen Compensation, Group Insurance etc. g) The Service Provider’s drivers should strictly follow the safety & security instructions of Cord ite Factory Aruvankadu including submission of Police Verification Report for all the drivers. h) The Service Provider’s drivers should abide the rules & regulations of Cordite Factory Aruvankadu. i) The Service Provider has to submit the bills of preceding month within the period of succeedi ng month. j) The Chief General Manager, C.F. Aruvankadu reserves the right to control the entry into the factory (or) estate to any driver employed by the Service Provider. k) The Chief General Manager, C.F. Aruvankadu reserves the right to short close (or) cancel th e contract without any notice. 13. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) File Attachment Click here to view the file. 14.
